nodes.note: The statement fixes clipping before merging and sorting by lower endpoint, although its accept correctly allows other sorted union scans and clipping afterward. State the invariant algorithm—compute the projected union by sorted merging and output its uncovered length within the required descent—and move those ordering choices to accept.

The statement unnecessarily fixes the tree representation to unit strips and includes the optional optimization of avoiding further updates to full nodes; its accept already allows compressed weighted gaps and other range-cover implementations. State that segment-tree range coverage maintains the union length used to determine the answer, leaving the representation and pruning optimization in accept.

The particular deque front/back convention is an implementation choice: reversing both ends gives the same 0-1 BFS. Keep the integer-height graph, 0-1 shortest-path algorithm, and output rule in the statement, and put the deque convention in accept as an example.

A solver can establish SCC contiguity from the free upward chain without yet establishing the exact equivalence between shaded elementary gaps and equal SCC labels. Separate these claims, or make the node the characterization of free-motion components and place contiguity in its supporting acceptance explanation.
